labels.text: Print an artifact's content, or write it to a file.
Write the content here instead of printing it. A directory takes the artifact's own name; a path with no extension gains one.

S28.24.needs: a signed-in account with at least one artifact
S28.24.note: No visible label says Download source. The command writes the artifact's content, and the chat form /artifacts show prints it and has no --out option.
steps: Run agi artifacts list and copy the id of a generated artifact.
Run agi artifacts show <id> --out ~/Desktop/ (use an existing folder).
Look at the path printed on screen and open that file. It should hold the artifact's content, which is the generated code.
Compare with Expected: the user can download the code. Note that the command downloads one artifact's content, not the whole app, and the word Download does not appear anywhere.
S28.24.where: Type agi artifacts show <id> --out <path> in the terminal (a directory path takes the artifact's own name). Run agi artifacts list first to get the id.

S28.26.note: Searched apps/cli/src for coding workspace, Open in, canvas, code canvas and workspace. No artifact action opens a coding workspace. The closest is agi artifacts show <id> --out <path> --open, which opens the file in the computer's default app, not a coding workspace. The phrase coding workspace appears only in the desktop folder consent text (apps/cli/src/lib.rs:861 and apps/cli/src/app_server/account_host.rs:69).

labels.text: Publish an artifact to a shareable URL.
Who can open the link: public (anyone with it) or workspace.

S28.27.needs: a signed-in account with an artifact of a publishable kind; a Free account can be tried first
S28.27.note: The workspace audience is refused unless the account has a workspace that can share artifacts; the Expected word preview does not appear in the CLI.
steps: Run agi artifacts list and copy the id of an artifact of a publishable kind (html, react, svg, mermaid, markdown, text or code).
Read the printed line that starts Published and copy the link it shows.
Open the link in a private browser window and compare with Expected: the app should open at a shareable link. The CLI calls it a shareable URL, not a preview link.
S28.27.where: Type agi artifacts publish <id> in the terminal. Add --audience workspace to share only with the workspace (default is public). Run agi artifacts list first to get the id.
